rules: Stop normalising by a guarded mean of a raw field. TS_MEAN($volume,21)+1e-8, TS_MEAN($high,21)+1e-8 and TS_MEAN($high,126)+1e-8 each drew an archive_subtree hit (5 shared nodes, 3 rejects). Every accept normalised by a derived series instead: TS_MEAN($high-$low,63), TS_SUM($high-$low,10), TS_SUM(ABS($return),21), TS_STD($return,w).

The TS_CORR($high-$low, dollar-volume, 63) family is exhausted. Raw $dollar_volume, /$open and /TS_MEAN($dollar_volume,63) all returned rho 0.961 to 0.977 against the same archive member. The two that cleared put the volume leg through TS_DELTA(...,5) or TS_RANK(...,10) and shortened the correlation window to 21, so change the leg's transform and the window together, not the normaliser.

Return legs only clear the cheap screen as self-normalising ratios. Short-over-long TS_STD (5 over 63) and TS_MAX/TS_SUM of ABS($return) at 21 sat at fitness 2.25 to 4.11; single-window TS_STD at 63 and 105, and TS_DECAY_LINEAR over TS_STD, stalled at |t| 0.89 to 0.97.
Drop raw $close kernels. $close/DELAY($close,w) ratios were the weakest cheap-screen bucket by a wide margin (|t| 0.42, 0.45, 0.50), and CS_RANK(TS_RANK($close,10)) is an alpha101 subtree.

Directional return aggregates buy almost nothing. SIGN sums, TS_MEAN/TS_STD sharpe forms, TS_ARGMAX(ABS($return),63) and summed raw OHLC gaps produced the three weakest accepts (0.382, 0.591, 0.603). Dispersion, concentration and correlation kernels produced everything above 1.9.

CS_DEMEAN(CS_RANK($roe)) as a leading term is spent: in one round it drew both a 5-node archive_subtree hit and a rho 0.901 correlation hit against the same archive member. CS_ZSCORE or plain CS_RANK on $accrual_gap and $asset_turnover carried the 3.1 to 4.1 accepts.

Rescaling a window is not a decorrelating edit. The 126-day channel-position kernel came back rho 0.858 against its 21-day twin. Spend mutation edits on replacing a whole leg; the one non-local reject wasted its budget scattering edits across wrapper, leg and window at once.
Keep total lookback at 126 days or less. A DELAY($close,189) leg was the round's only coverage failure at 0.896; every expression at 126 or below cleared the gate, including 126-day TS_CORR.
